description: Two sales workflow DAGs for professional services.

workflows.name: Lead Qualification Flow
workflows.description: Score ≥ 70 auto-qualifies. 40–69 routes to L2 nurture decision. < 40 routes to L2 decline confirmation. Creates tasks on acceptance.

workflows.name: Proposal Follow-up
workflows.description: 5-day no-response trigger. DEAL_COACH drafts follow-up. Auto-sends for small deals, L2 review for large.
